plugin.description: Extract text and structured Markdown from any image or PDF.
plugin.label: OCR

extract.description: Calls the configured OCR provider chain and returns per-page Markdown plus optional bounding boxes.
extract.label: Extract text from an image or PDF

abbyy-cloud.description: Enterprise-grade OCR with 200+ languages. Two-stage submit + poll API.
abbyy-cloud.label: ABBYY Cloud OCR

anthropic-vision.description: Uses your main Anthropic API key. Returns Markdown only — no bounding boxes.
anthropic-vision.label: Claude (vision)

apple-vision.description: Tauri (macOS) via a Swift sidecar, or Capacitor (iOS) via VNRecognizeTextRequest.
apple-vision.label: Apple Vision

aws-textract.description: Image OCR plus structured forms / tables. Uses SigV4 signing. PDFs must be rasterized first.
aws-textract.label: AWS Textract

azure-document-intelligence.description: Asynchronous analyze API with Markdown + paragraph blocks. Models: prebuilt-read, prebuilt-layout, prebuilt-invoice, custom.
azure-document-intelligence.label: Azure AI Document Intelligence

gemini-vision.description: Uses your main Gemini / Google AI API key. Returns Markdown only — no bounding boxes.
gemini-vision.label: Gemini (vision)

google-vision.description: Document text detection with paragraph-level bounding boxes and per-word confidence.
google-vision.label: Google Cloud Vision

lark-basic.description: Lark Open Platform basic_recognize — App ID + App Secret. Best for Chinese + English short text.
lark-basic.label: Feishu / Lark

local-http.description: Adapter for self-hosted OCR servers (Umi-OCR, PaddleOCR-Server). Configure the endpoint URL and request dialect.
local-http.label: Local HTTP (self-hosted)

mathpix.description: Math, chemistry, and handwriting specialist. Outputs LaTeX/Markdown.
mathpix.label: Mathpix

mistral-ocr.description: Markdown-first document OCR with strong table preservation. Handles multi-page PDFs and handwritten text.
mistral-ocr.label: Mistral OCR

mlkit-android.description: Capacitor (Android) only. Latin, Chinese, Devanagari, Japanese, and Korean scripts.
mlkit-android.label: ML Kit Text Recognition

nanonets.description: Generic OCR model or custom-trained extraction. Returns plain text plus bounding boxes.
nanonets.label: Nanonets

ocr-space.description: Generous free tier; 200+ languages. Engine 3 supports the broadest language set.
ocr-space.label: OCR.space

ocrs.description: Pure-Rust cross-platform OCR via ocrs + RTen. No system dependencies; English-biased. Models (~12 MB) download on first use.
ocrs.label: ocrs (local)

openai-vision.description: Uses your main OpenAI API key. Returns Markdown only — no bounding boxes.
openai-vision.label: OpenAI (vision)

paddle-ocr.description: PP-OCRv5 via oar-ocr + ONNX Runtime. Strongest open CJK accuracy. Models (~17 MB) download on first use.
paddle-ocr.label: PaddleOCR (local)

tesseract-native.description: Tauri desktop only. Statically linked libtesseract + leptonica via tesseract-rs.
tesseract-native.label: Tesseract (native)

tesseract-wasm.description: Browser-side OCR powered by tesseract.js. Works offline; ships ~2 MB WASM core.
tesseract-wasm.label: Tesseract (WASM)

windows-media-ocr.description: Windows-bundled OCR via the winocr crate. Requires an MSIX-packaged build.
windows-media-ocr.label: Windows.Media.Ocr
